svg.title: LLM Preflight
svg.desc: Check LLM responses against the output rules your application depends on, before changing a model, prompt, schema, or provider. Local CLI, GitHub Action and MCP server.

g.text: Model, prompt, schema or provider: keep the decision, latency and cost as evidence.
